name: KMC (Kuei Meng) International Inc.
summary: KMC (Kuei Meng) International Inc. manufactures and sells various types of chains, auto parts, motorcycle components, and vehicle components in Asia, Europe, and the United States. The company offers bicycle chains, automobile timing systems, and garage door openers, as well as provides after-sales service treatment for electric bicycles. It is also involved in investing activities; and leasing owned properties and plants. KMC (Kuei Meng) International Inc. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
